name: Google Translate
tagline: Google Translate is a free AI translation service supporting 133 languages, available on the web, as a mobile app, and as an API. It offers instant camera translation of signs and menus, conversation mode for real-time spoken translation, and a document translation feature that preserves formatting. Despite newer competitors, it remains the go-to for quick, accessible translation worldwide.
